movie.title: The Furious
movie.overview: When YouTuber-boxer Danial insults their late father's name, brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite - one fighting for redemption, the other for revenge - in a battle that will decide not just who wins, but what remains of The Furious legacy.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Driven by revenge and the pursuit of redemption, estranged brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite to face a trash-talking YouTuber-boxer who defamed their late father.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After arrogant YouTuber-boxer Danial publicly insults their late father's legacy, estranged brothers Firdaus and Hakim are forced back together. While one brother seeks personal redemption, the other is consumed by a desire for vengeance. Their shared battle in and out of the ring ultimately tests their bond and determines what truly remains of 'The Furious' legacy.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The story follows brothers Firdaus and Hakim, whose once-tight relationship has frayed over time due to personal conflicts and divergent life paths. Their peaceful separate lives are disrupted when Danial, a provocative YouTuber-turned-boxer, publicly dishonors the memory of their late father to build hype for his next big fight. Outraged by the disrespect, both brothers step back into the combat world to defend their family name. Firdaus approaches the conflict as a path toward inner peace and redemption, attempting to heal old wounds. In contrast, Hakim is fueled purely by anger, risking his own future in a reckless pursuit of retribution against Danial. As the fight approaches, the brothers must resolve their own deep-seated rivalries while preparing for the tough match ahead. In the end, their showdown with Danial forces them to confront what family really means and decide whether vengeance is worth destroying their shared bond.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When internet personality Danial disrespects their deceased father's legacy, brothers Firdaus and Hakim are drawn back into the world of fighting. Facing internal strife and external provocation, the two must navigate competing motivations—one seeking a chance at redemption, the other consumed by revenge—to protect their family name and determine the fate of 'The Furious' legacy.

story_structure.climax: The narrative reaches its peak during the intense final battle against Danial, where physical combat mirrors the brothers' internal struggle over vengeance versus true honor.
story_structure.conflict: Driven by differing motivations—one seeking redemption and the other out for vengeance—the estranged brothers must reunite to confront Danial and defend their family's honor.
story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of the fight settles the dispute with Danial and defines what truly remains of The Furious legacy, reshaping the bond between Firdaus and Hakim.
story_structure.introduction: Brothers Firdaus and Hakim are reintroduced against the backdrop of their family's martial arts legacy, while popular YouTuber-boxer Danial publicly dishonors their late father.
story_structure.risingAction: As the brothers prepare for the high-stakes confrontation, personal grievances surface and training tensions escalate, forcing them to navigate their contrasting philosophies on fighting and legacy.
